description: Nissth Diagnostic Bridge — general-purpose PostgreSQL binding. Diagnostic-only first slice: schema introspection, query plans, index hygiene, lock state, migration history. Accepts a libpq connection string via NISSTH_PG_URL env var or per-call scope.extra.connection_string override.

tools.name: schema_lens
tools.description: Lists tables/views/materialized views; per-table columns; FK relationship graph. Default mode 'full' emits all three sections.

tools.name: query_plan
tools.description: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) for a SQL statement. analyze/buffers modes refuse mutating statements (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/CREATE/DROP/ALTER/GRANT/REVOKE/COPY/VACUUM/CLUSTER/REINDEX).

tools.name: index_audit
tools.description: Index hygiene: pg_stat_user_indexes usage stats; idx_scan=0 unused indexes; duplicate index sets; bloat estimate via pgstattuple (graceful fallback if extension missing).

tools.name: lock_audit
tools.description: Live lock state from pg_locks JOIN pg_stat_activity. waiting mode includes pg_blocking_pids() graph. Requires pg_read_all_stats role for cross-session visibility; otherwise reports only the connecting session.

tools.name: migration_status
tools.description: Reads applied + failed migrations from flyway_schema_history or databasechangelog. auto mode detects whichever exists. Does NOT list pending migrations (that requires filesystem access — owned by the application-side binding).

scope_extra_keys_doc.connection_string: libpq URL — postgresql://user:pass@host:port/dbname?sslmode=...; if absent, falls back to NISSTH_PG_URL env var.
scope_extra_keys_doc.sql: [query_plan only] The SQL statement to plan.
scope_extra_keys_doc.params: [query_plan only] Bind parameters as a JSON array. Order matches $1, $2, ... in sql.
scope_extra_keys_doc.min_age_days: [index_audit unused mode] Minimum index age in days before flagging as unused (default 7).
scope_extra_keys_doc.min_age_seconds: [lock_audit long_running mode] Minimum session age in seconds (default 30).
